Additionally, UNRWA USA earns high third-party ratings, including an <cite id="1">overall score of 91.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and a <cite id="1">100/100 leadership rating</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: UNRWA USA lifts up the voices and lives of Palestine refugees through targeted humanitarian assistance, education, and healthcare programs. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="12">$51,495,126 in total revenue</cite> to support critical relief efforts in regions including Gaza and the West Bank. UNRWA USA is <cite id="2">zakat-eligible</cite>, allowing Muslim donors to fulfill their religious obligations through verified humanitarian channels. The organization operates with high financial efficiency, directing a <cite id="1">93.4% program expense ratio</cite> toward direct services. This program spending beats the <cite id="1">75% industry benchmark</cite> and exceeds the <cite id="1">89.2% peer median</cite>. Furthermore, fundraising operations remain lean, spending only <cite id="1">$0.05 per $1 raised</cite>. Third-party evaluators highlight this performance, as UNRWA USA holds an <cite id="1">overall score of 91.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> alongside a Platinum Seal of Transparency.
